To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the most common renal disease is glomerulonephritis (GN), and the most common GN is focal segmental glomerulosclerosis (FSGS) followed by membranous GN.

1. The incidence of renal diseases in Hungary is 1: 10.000, 2. The most prevalent renal diseases are glomerular diseases, 3. The most frequent glomerular diseases are IgA nephropathy and focal segmental glomerular sclerosis.

The most common primary glomerulopathies in adults were focal segmental glomerulosclerosis (FSGS) (16.4%), IgA nephropathy (IgAN) (15.6%), membranous nephropathy (MN) (13.8%) and membranoproliferative glomerulonephritis (MPGN) (12.5%).
